title: ZSI 111th Foundation Day: Discovers 709 New Faunal Records (India Total 1,05,953 Species)
summary: Releases 'Animal Discoveries 2025' and 'Fauna of India Checklist 3.0' at Kolkata summit.

blocks.content: Releases 'Animal Discoveries 2025' and 'Fauna of India Checklist 3.0' at Kolkata summit.

items: Faunal Biodiversity: 709 new faunal records added in 2025 (483 new to science, 226 new to India), raising India's total faunal wealth to 1,05,953 species.
State Leader: Kerala led regional species discoveries (98 new species), followed by West Bengal, Karnataka, and Arunachal Pradesh.
Digital Platforms: Launched 'Fauna of India Checklist 3.0' and 'PaleoIndia Portal' (specimen fossil mapping across 28 states and 8 UTs).

blocks.title: Static Background & GK Context
blocks.summary: Zoological Survey of India (ZSI) established July 1, 1916 | Director: Dr. Dhriti Banerjee | HQ: Kolkata.
